### Astrobiologia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore o que a vida fora da Terra pode exigir e como cientistas identificam evidências confiáveis de sua existência.

#### Condições para a vida

Skills: 4

[conditionsForLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/conditionsForLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluating environments for life requires explicit biological and geochemical assumptions; familiar Earth conditions are useful evidence, not universal proof.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Considere quais ambientes e processos químicos poderiam permitir a existência de vida.

##### Análogos de extremófilos

[extremophileAnalogues.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/extremophileAnalogues.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how Earth organisms in extreme environments inform hypotheses about extraterrestrial habitats without proving life exists there.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use exemplos de vida em ambientes extremos da Terra para investigar possíveis habitats extraterrestres.

##### Habitabilidade

[habitability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate energy sources, chemical building blocks, solvent availability and environmental stability as possible prerequisites for known life.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a energia, a química, os líquidos e a estabilidade podem tornar um ambiente habitável.

##### Habitabilidade ao longo do tempo

[habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how a world's environmental history may change its potential to support life.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Investigue como mudanças ambientais em um mundo afetam seu potencial de sustentar vida.

##### Química prebiótica

[prebioticChemistry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/prebioticChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain plausible nonliving chemical pathways relevant to life's origins while distinguishing hypotheses from established histories.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como processos químicos sem vida poderiam produzir componentes importantes para a origem da vida.

#### Evidências de vida

Skills: 5

[evidenceOfLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/evidenceOfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposed sign of life must be weighed against nonbiological processes and the limits of the measuring instrument.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda a distinguir possíveis sinais de vida de explicações que não envolvem organismos vivos.

[abioticFalsePositives.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/abioticFalsePositives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify nonbiological processes capable of producing signals superficially similar to biosignatures.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como processos não biológicos podem imitar sinais que parecem indicar vida.

##### Bioassinaturas

[biosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/biosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate chemical, morphological or other candidate indicators that might be produced by living systems.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça possíveis pistas químicas ou físicas que possam estar ligadas a organismos vivos.

##### Critérios de evidência para detectar vida

[lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish suggestive observations from convergent, independently checked evidence sufficient to support a life claim.

[planetaryProtection.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/planetaryProtection.data.ts)

##### Tecnoassinaturas

[technosignatures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/technosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret possible observable indicators of technology without confusing an unexplained signal with confirmed intelligence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Considere o que um sinal incomum poderia revelar sobre tecnologia sem tratá-lo como prova de inteligência.

[solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/solarSystemLifeSearches.data.ts)

[subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts)

### Instrumentos e evidências astronômicas

Groups: 6 · Skills: 30

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomy infers properties of remote objects from electromagnetic radiation, gravitational effects, particles and spacecraft observations. This domain covers what an observation can reveal, how instruments and methods constrain the evidence, and how competing interpretations are evaluated, not the engineering construction of observatories and spacecraft.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como astrônomos reúnem evidências usando luz, gravidade, partículas e missões espaciais para estudar mundos distantes.

#### Espectros astronômicos

Skills: 5

[astronomicalSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/astronomicalSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light encodes information about temperature, composition and motion through its distribution across wavelength and the signatures imprinted by matter.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como separar a luz por comprimento de onda revela propriedades de objetos distantes.

##### Linhas espectrais de absorção

[absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dark spectral features produced by matter absorbing characteristic wavelengths from background radiation.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça linhas escuras no espectro como pistas de matéria que absorve luz.

##### Espectros contínuos

[continuousSpectra.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/continuousSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer broad thermal properties from the distribution of emitted light across wavelengths while recognizing idealized blackbody assumptions.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use um espectro contínuo para explorar a temperatura de um objeto e a luz que ele emite.

##### Deslocamento Doppler

[dopplerShift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/dopplerShift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret wavelength shifts due to relative radial motion, distinguishing this local effect from cosmological expansion.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use mudanças no comprimento de onda para investigar movimentos em direção ao observador ou para longe dele.

##### Linhas espectrais de emissão

[emissionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/emissionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret discrete bright features produced by matter radiating at characteristic wavelengths.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça linhas espectrais brilhantes como pistas sobre a matéria que emite luz.

##### Observação em múltiplos comprimentos de onda

[multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observations in different electromagnetic bands to distinct physical components and processes within one object.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Combine imagens e medições de diferentes faixas de luz para compreender um objeto celeste.

[stellarParallax.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/distancesAndPhysicalProperties/skills/stellarParallax.data.ts)

#### Investigações gravitacionais e por partículas

Skills: 4

[gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational lensing, gravitational waves and astrophysical particles supply information that differs from ordinary electromagnetic imaging and spectroscopy; a multimessenger inference combines distinct independent signals. Lensing is observed through light affected by gravity and is not itself a non-electromagnetic measurement.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como os neutrinos revelam eventos de alta energia que a luz não mostra por completo.

### Mecânica celeste

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

[gravitationalMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/gravitationalMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational interactions produce trajectories governed by mass, initial conditions and the reference frame in which motion is described.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como a gravidade governa o movimento dos corpos celestes.

##### Movimento baricêntrico

[barycentricMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/barycentricMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why interacting celestial bodies orbit a shared center of mass rather than one body always remaining stationary.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que dois corpos em órbita se movem ao redor de um centro de massa comum.

##### Primeira lei de Kepler

[keplersFirstLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersFirstLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the elliptical-orbit relation, with the central gravitating body at one focus in the idealized two-body model, to the geometry of bound orbits.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça que uma órbita ideal pode ser elíptica, com o corpo central em um dos focos.

##### Segunda lei de Kepler

[keplersSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the equal-areas-in-equal-times relation to explain variation in orbital speed as an orbiting body changes its distance from the central focus.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que um corpo em órbita se move mais rápido quando está mais perto do corpo central.

##### Terceira lei de Kepler

[keplersThirdLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersThirdLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the square of orbital period to the cube of semi-major axis with the appropriate gravitational mass dependence and limitations of the two-body model.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Relacione o período orbital de um objeto com o tamanho da órbita e a massa responsável pela atração gravitacional.

##### Energia orbital

[orbitalEnergy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/orbitalEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate gravitational potential and kinetic energy to bound and unbound orbital trajectories.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a energia determina se uma órbita permanece gravitacionalmente ligada ou permite escapar.

##### Gravitação universal

[universalGravitation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/universalGravitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the dependence of gravitational attraction on interacting masses and separation to astronomical situations.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use as massas dos corpos e as distâncias entre eles para compreender a atração gravitacional.

#### Órbitas e rotações

Skills: 5

[orbitsAndRotations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/orbitsAndRotations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Orbital shapes and body orientations are specified through distinct physical parameters that affect long-term celestial behavior.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descreva e compare as formas, os períodos e as orientações dos movimentos celestes.

##### Rotação axial

[axialRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the spin of a world about its axis, including rotation period and direction, independently of the tilt or precession of that axis.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descreva como um corpo celeste gira em torno de seu próprio eixo.

##### Inclinação axial

[axialTilt.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialTilt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the angle between a body's spin axis and orbital reference direction and explain its influence on illumination geometry and seasons.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a inclinação do eixo de um mundo altera a distribuição da luz que recebe.

##### Elementos orbitais

[orbitalElements.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalElements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret inclination, eccentricity and other orbital descriptors when comparing celestial trajectories.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Interprete os parâmetros que descrevem a forma e a orientação de uma órbita.

##### Períodos orbitais

[orbitalPeriods.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalPeriods.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the time needed to complete an orbit and compare sidereal and synodic periods, distinguishing orbital revolution from rotation about the body's own axis.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie o tempo de uma volta em torno de outro corpo do tempo de uma rotação em torno do próprio eixo.

##### Rotação síncrona

[synchronousRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/synchronousRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spin–orbit coupling can produce a repeating orientation toward an orbital partner.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que alguns corpos mantêm quase sempre a mesma face voltada para o corpo que orbitam.

### Objetos cósmicos

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore os diferentes tipos de objetos e estruturas do Universo e como os astrônomos os classificam.

#### Famílias de objetos

Skills: 4

[objectFamilies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/objectFamilies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification of astronomical entities requires more than their appearance in a photograph: a point source, a diffuse cloud, a cluster and an extended galaxy may be distinguished by physical evidence and scale.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como os astrônomos identificam diferentes tipos de objetos usando evidências físicas, e não apenas a aparência.

##### Classificação de objetos celestes

[celestialObjectClassification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/celestialObjectClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify astronomical sources as stellar bodies, planetary bodies, compact remnants, diffuse clouds, star clusters, galaxies or other broad physical types using characteristic evidence rather than appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça as principais categorias de objetos celestes por suas propriedades físicas.

##### Objetos difusos e compostos

[diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate diffuse nebulae, gravitationally associated groups and composite galaxies by their constituents, structure and binding rather than surface resemblance.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie nuvens de gás, grupos de estrelas e galáxias pelo que contêm e por sua organização.

##### Objetos e fenômenos

[objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish enduring physical objects and systems from observed events or effects such as eclipses, meteors, flares and transient brightenings, even when both occur in object catalogs.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie um objeto celeste duradouro de um evento como um eclipse ou uma erupção.

##### Limites entre estrelas, objetos subestelares e planetas

[stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare physically distinct stars, brown dwarfs and planetary-mass bodies using fusion and mass constraints while acknowledging uncertainties near classification boundaries.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore as diferenças entre estrelas, anãs marrons e planetas, inclusive onde suas categorias se sobrepõem.

#### Organização e pertencimento

Skills: 3

[organizationAndMembership.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/organizationAndMembership.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's membership in a system is a different property from its type; the same class of object can be gravitationally bound, ejected or found in a sparse galactic environment.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como os objetos fazem parte de sistemas astronômicos maiores ou se movem de forma independente.

##### Planetas errantes

[freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain planetary-mass objects not gravitationally bound to a host star, including proposed ejection or isolated-formation origins and detection by microlensing or thermal infrared emission; distinguish low illumination from a complete absence of radiation.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Saiba como planetas sem uma estrela hospedeira podem se formar, se mover e ser detectados.

##### Sistemas ligados gravitacionalmente

[gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish satellite systems, planetary systems, multiple stars, star clusters, galaxies and galaxy clusters by physical membership and characteristic scales.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare sistemas planetários, aglomerados estelares, galáxias e outros sistemas unidos pela gravidade.

##### Pertencimento e isolamento dos objetos

[objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an astronomical object is a member of a larger bound system or is apparently isolated, and explain why gravitational context does not by itself determine intrinsic object type.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra se um objeto faz parte de um sistema maior sem confundir essa relação com o tipo de objeto que ele é.

### Cosmologia

Groups: 5 · Skills: 17

[cosmology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cosmology tests models for the Universe's large-scale composition, history and expansion using observations with known horizons and uncertainties. Unresolved questions must remain distinguishable from established evidence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Investigue a expansão, a história e a estrutura em grande escala do Universo com evidências astronômicas.

#### Componentes cósmicos e limites

Skills: 3

[cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational and expansion measurements constrain otherwise unseen components, while cosmological parameters and theoretical uncertainties limit the interpretations that can be supported by available evidence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como medições cósmicas indicam componentes e questões que ainda não conseguimos explicar totalmente.

##### Evidências da energia escura

[darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why observations of accelerated expansion motivate a dark-energy component or changes to gravitational models.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Examine as evidências de que a expansão do Universo está acelerando.

##### Evidências da matéria escura

[darkMatterEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkMatterEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dynamical, lensing and cosmological evidence for unseen gravitating mass while recognizing remaining theoretical alternatives.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore por que os astrônomos deduzem a existência de matéria invisível a partir de evidências gravitacionais.

##### Limites do conhecimento cosmológico

[limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish empirical constraints from open problems concerning early conditions, dark components and the global extent of the Universe.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Distinga o que as observações estabelecem sobre o Universo das grandes questões ainda sem resposta.

#### Expansão cósmica

Skills: 4

[cosmicExpansion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/cosmicExpansion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Large-scale redshift patterns support an evolving cosmic geometry, not an ordinary explosion into pre-existing empty space.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra o que as observações revelam sobre a expansão do Universo.

##### Modelos cosmológicos

[cosmologicalModels.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the predictions and assumptions of simplified expanding-Universe models against observations.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare modelos de expansão do Universo, suas hipóteses e previsões.

##### Desvio para o vermelho cosmológico

[cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain wavelength stretching associated with the expansion of space, distinguishing it from local Doppler motion.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda como a expansão do espaço alonga os comprimentos de onda da luz em viagem.

##### Expansão e sistemas ligados

[expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the expansion of the Universe does not automatically enlarge gravitationally bound local systems.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que a expansão do espaço não afasta simplesmente planetas, estrelas ou galáxias.

##### Relação de Hubble–Lemaître

[hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate galaxy recession measurements and distance to empirical evidence for expansion within its domain of applicability.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Relacione distâncias e desvios para o vermelho medidos de galáxias com a expansão cósmica.

#### Escalas cósmicas

Skills: 4

[cosmicScales.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/cosmicScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distances and times become linked by the finite speed of light, which limits how much of the Universe can be observed.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore as imensas distâncias e os tempos envolvidos na observação do cosmos.

##### Medidas de distância cósmica

[cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common cosmological distance concepts when relating observed brightness, redshift and scale.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare as diferentes formas de definir e medir distâncias na cosmologia.

##### Horizontes cósmicos

[cosmicHorizons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicHorizons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret limits on observable or causally connected regions without treating them as physical walls.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore os limites de até onde sinais podem chegar a nós ou influenciar outras regiões.

[lookbackTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/lookbackTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distant observations show objects at earlier cosmic epochs.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra por que observar mais longe no espaço também significa olhar para o passado.

##### Universo observável

[observableUniverse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/observableUniverse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the observable region set by signal travel and cosmic history from claims about the entire Universe.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que o Universo observável não é necessariamente todo o Universo.

#### Estrutura e evolução cósmicas

Skills: 2

[cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Density perturbations, gravity and cosmic expansion shape the cosmic web over time. This branch focuses on spatial organization and dynamical evolution, as distinct from the initial hot state or the physical nature of the Universe's dark components.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Investigue como a gravidade molda a matéria em grandes estruturas ao longo da história cósmica.

##### Formação de estruturas cósmicas

[cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how initially small matter-density differences grow into galaxies and large-scale structure.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como pequenas diferenças iniciais na densidade da matéria se transformaram em estruturas cósmicas.

##### Teia cósmica

[cosmicWeb.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicWeb.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how filaments, clusters and voids trace the large-scale distribution of matter.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore a vasta rede de filamentos de galáxias, aglomerados e regiões vazias.

#### Modelos e evidências do Universo primitivo

Skills: 4

[earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The early hot and dense Universe is reconstructed from relic radiation, primordial abundances and theoretical models whose predictions and evidence have different degrees of support.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore as evidências usadas para reconstruir o Universo primitivo e quente.

##### Inflação cósmica

[cosmicInflation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicInflation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the hypothesized early accelerated-expansion phase, distinguish its predicted consequences from direct observation and evaluate what existing cosmic evidence can and cannot establish.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore a ideia da inflação cósmica e diferencie previsões de evidências confirmadas.

##### Radiação cósmica de fundo em micro-ondas

[cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret relic microwave radiation and its spatial variations as evidence about the early Universe.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Investigue o fraco brilho de micro-ondas deixado pelo Universo primitivo.

##### Modelo do Big Bang quente

[hotBigBangModel.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/hotBigBangModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the evidence-supported early evolution of the observable Universe without claiming that the model fully explains its ultimate origin.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra o que o modelo do Big Bang quente explica e o que não estabelece.

##### Nucleossíntese primordial

[primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the predicted formation of light nuclei and why their observed abundances test early-Universe models.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Veja como modelos do Universo primitivo preveem as quantidades de elementos leves.

### Terra, Lua e Sol

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[earthMoonAndSun.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonAndSun.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Here the distinctive geometry of Earth's viewpoint, rotation and revolution produces observable cycles. The scientific emphasis is on explaining familiar sky events from physical arrangements rather than on general geography or atmospheric meteorology.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda como os movimentos e as posições da Terra, da Lua e do Sol criam padrões conhecidos no céu.

Skills: 3

[earthMoonInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/earthMoonInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Earth–Moon system is a long-term dynamical pair whose interactions create measurable effects on Earth and its satellite.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como a Lua e a Terra influenciam uma à outra por meio da gravidade.

[lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts)

[oceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/oceanTides.data.ts)

[lunarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/lunarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions and stages of a lunar eclipse as the Moon encounters Earth's shadow.

[solarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/solarEclipses.data.ts)

[lunarMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarMotion.data.ts)

#### Formação de estrelas

Skills: 4

[starFormation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/starFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Star birth occurs inside interstellar gas and dust and progresses through distinct gravitational and thermal stages.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Investigue como as estrelas nascem em grandes nuvens de gás e poeira.

##### Colapso de nuvens moleculares

[molecularCloudCollapse.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/molecularCloudCollapse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gravitational collapse of dense gas can initiate star formation against thermal and other support.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique como regiões densas de gás podem colapsar e iniciar a formação de estrelas.

##### Protoestrelas

[protostars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the stage during which a contracting young stellar object has not yet reached stable hydrogen fusion.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique a fase inicial de uma estrela, antes do começo da fusão estável de hidrogênio.

##### Discos protoestelares

[protostellarDisks.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostellarDisks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how circumstellar accretion disks transport matter and angular momentum during the early growth of stars.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como um disco de matéria alimenta uma estrela em formação.

##### Jatos protoestelares

[protostellarJets.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostellarJets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the observed collimated outflows from young stellar systems and how their association with disks and magnetic fields constrains star-formation models.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda por que estrelas jovens podem lançar jatos estreitos de matéria em movimento.

#### Classificação estelar e subestelar

Skills: 6

[stellarAndSubstellarClassification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/stellarAndSubstellarClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Spectra, temperature, luminosity, mass, multiplicity and composition provide complementary ways to group luminous stars and related substellar bodies, while observational class need not imply a unique evolutionary history.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore os diferentes tipos de estrelas e objetos relacionados por seus espectros, massas e brilho.

##### Estrelas binárias e múltiplas

[binaryAndMultipleStars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/binaryAndMultipleStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gravitationally bound stellar systems are identified and used to estimate stellar properties.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como pares e grupos de estrelas orbitam uns aos outros.

##### Anãs marrons

[brownDwarfs.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/brownDwarfs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish substellar objects below the sustained hydrogen-fusion threshold from stars, including their cooling, atmospheric spectra and uncertain classification near planetary masses.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como as anãs marrons diferem das estrelas e dos objetos de massa planetária.

##### Diagrama de Hertzsprung–Russell

[hertzsprungRussellDiagram.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/hertzsprungRussellDiagram.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the distribution of stars by luminosity and temperature and identify major evolutionary regions.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Leia um diagrama de Hertzsprung–Russell para comparar temperaturas, luminosidades e fases das estrelas.

##### Populações estelares

[stellarPopulations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/stellarPopulations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish stellar populations by typical ages, chemical abundances and locations without treating the categories as absolute.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare populações de estrelas com diferentes idades, composições e localizações.

##### Tipos espectrais estelares

[stellarSpectralTypes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/stellarSpectralTypes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify stars by temperature-sensitive spectral characteristics rather than by color alone.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Identifique as classes espectrais das estrelas por características de sua luz.

##### Estrelas variáveis

[variableStars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/variableStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify intrinsic stellar brightness variation by physical mechanism, timescale or periodicity, distinguishing it from apparent variation caused by eclipsing companions.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça as diferentes causas das variações no brilho de uma estrela.

#### Evolução estelar

Skills: 5

[stellarEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/stellarEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mass and composition strongly constrain the duration and physical stages of a star's nuclear-burning lifetime.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como as estrelas mudam à medida que consomem seu combustível nuclear.

##### Fusão estelar avançada

[advancedStellarFusion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/advancedStellarFusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how later nuclear-burning stages depend on stellar mass and can create heavier nuclei.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como algumas estrelas realizam fusão de elementos mais pesados nas fases finais de suas vidas.

##### Sequência principal

[mainSequence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/mainSequence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why stars can remain in a long-lived core hydrogen-burning state and why mass changes its duration.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que as estrelas passam grande parte da vida fundindo hidrogênio em seus núcleos.

##### Gigantes vermelhas

[redGiants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/redGiants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the expansion and cooling of stellar envelopes during post-main-sequence evolution and distinguish the relevant evolutionary paths by progenitor mass.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como as estrelas se expandem e esfriam na superfície ao se tornarem gigantes vermelhas.

##### Tempos de vida das estrelas

[stellarLifetimes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/stellarLifetimes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the evolutionary timescales of stars with different initial masses.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare quanto tempo as estrelas vivem de acordo com suas massas iniciais.

##### Supergigantes

[supergiants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/supergiants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the very large sizes and high luminosities of massive evolved stars and their connection to advanced stellar evolution and mass loss.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Reconheça o tamanho enorme e a alta luminosidade de estrelas massivas evoluídas.

#### Propriedades físicas das estrelas

Skills: 5

[stellarProperties.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/stellarProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observed spectra and brightness are combined with models to infer physical characteristics that cannot be measured by direct sampling.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Aprenda como os astrônomos medem e inferem as propriedades físicas das estrelas.

##### Equilíbrio hidrostático estelar

[stellarHydrostaticEquilibrium.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarHydrostaticEquilibrium.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how the balance of inward gravitational forces and outward pressure gradients sustains an approximately stable star and how disruption of the balance causes structural changes.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda como a gravidade e a pressão interna mantêm uma estrela em equilíbrio.

##### Luminosidade estelar

[stellarLuminosity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarLuminosity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish total emitted power from the light received by an observer and infer luminosity from suitable measurements.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Diferencie a energia emitida por uma estrela de seu brilho aparente visto da Terra.

##### Massa estelar

[stellarMass.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine or constrain stellar mass from orbital dynamics or other model-dependent observations.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use medições orbitais e modelos para estimar a massa de uma estrela.

##### Raio estelar

[stellarRadius.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarRadius.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a star's size from luminosity, temperature, eclipses or other relevant evidence.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como os astrônomos inferem o raio de uma estrela a partir de sua luz e outras observações.

##### Temperatura estelar

[stellarTemperature.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarTemperature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how stellar spectra and emitted energy distributions constrain effective temperature.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Use as cores e os padrões da luz estelar para investigar sua temperatura.

#### Remanescentes estelares

Skills: 6

[stellarRemnants.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/stellarRemnants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The final states of stars differ according to progenitor mass, mass loss and binary interactions; extreme events redistribute energy and elements.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore os remanescentes compactos e os finais explosivos de diferentes tipos de estrelas.

##### Enriquecimento cósmico de elementos

[cosmicElementEnrichment.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/cosmicElementEnrichment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how stellar nucleosynthesis and explosive or ejective events change the chemical composition of surrounding space.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Veja como estrelas e explosões estelares espalham elementos pelo espaço ao redor.

##### Estrelas de nêutrons

[neutronStars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/neutronStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the physical properties and formation of ultra-compact neutron-rich remnants supported by dense matter, including limits imposed by mass and rotation.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Descubra como o colapso do núcleo de uma estrela pode formar uma estrela de nêutrons.

##### Pulsares

[pulsars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/pulsars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic electromagnetic pulses as beams from rotating magnetized neutron stars and distinguish an observational pulsar designation from a separate stellar-remnant type.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explique por que estrelas de nêutrons em rotação podem emitir pulsos regulares de radiação.

##### Buracos negros de massa estelar

[stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation and observational inference of compact remnants with event horizons.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Explore como se formam buracos negros de massa estelar e como os astrônomos detectam seus efeitos.

##### Supernovas

[supernovae.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/supernovae.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major physical mechanisms that produce stellar explosions and interpret their observational signatures.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Compare os diferentes processos que provocam explosões de supernova.

##### Anãs brancas

[whiteDwarfs.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/whiteDwarfs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a compact electron-degeneracy-supported remnant forms after some stars shed their outer layers.

**User-friendly description (pt):** Entenda como algumas estrelas deixam anãs brancas densas como remanescentes.
